thread:
mara: Drafting copy for the webinar + benchmark deliverable — working title: 'Lower inference cost without losing latency' — we need a tight one-liner vs cloud AI platforms, managed LLM APIs, and infra vendors. High-level angle: production economics > model ownership. Thoughts?

diego: Love the angle. Can we be concrete: include Q3 bench numbers (cost per 1M tokens, p50/p95 latency) — those resonate with eng folks.

sumit: Agree on concrete metrics. Also: avoid competitor names. Use categories: 'cloud AI endpoints', 'managed LLM APIs', 'self-hosted runtimes / infra vendors'. Keep claims attribute-based.

elaine: For SDRs want 3 quick hooks: 1) predictable latency at scale, 2) unit-cost controls (batching + cache), 3) deployment parity across hosted/dedicated/private. Need 1-sentence opener for outreach.

diego: Quick inbound-routing rules sketch — copy for ops:
```
if intent == "benchmark" or intent contains "cost": route -> BenchOps
if intent == "enterprise security": route -> AE-enterprise
if region == "APAC" and capacity_need > 50gpu: route -> Dedicated-sales
else -> SDR-bucket
```
Use this to seed lead forms / hidden routing field.

mara: Good. Can we add one slide on fallback policies and graceful degradation? Customers ask about reliability more than raw perf. Also call out our automatic model-variant fallback + cross-region failover. :+1:

sumit: I'll sketch a 6-row mini-battlecard (objection / short response):
- "Your managed endpoints are easier" -> "True. But they trade control for predictability; Redwood gives same API surface + controls for tuning cost/latency."
- "We can self-host for cheaper" -> "Self-hosting hides ops risk and variance; we provide predictable economics + rollouts."
- "What's the upgrade path to Dedicated?" -> "Pin models, traffic shift policies, and simple subscription upgrade — no code changes."
I'll fill the rest.

elaine: Anticipated webinar Qs for Q&A doc: "How do you compare to X's managed endpoints?", "What's the SLA for Dedicated?", "Is private deploy audited?", "How much engineering effort for migration?" — prepping answers now. :thinking_face:

salesops-bot: New webinar created: https://events.redwood.ai/bench-webinar-2026-05-12 — registration page live. Add routing tag: "webinar_bench_5_12"

mara: Next steps: Diego update benchmark figures & slide artifacts by EOD, Sumit to draft the 6 objection responses, Elaine to produce the 3 SDR hooks + Q&A answers, I'll assemble slides and a one-pager. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:

diego: On it — updating numbers now, will flag any discrepancies.

sumit: I'll drop a first pass of the battlecard in this thread by 11:30am.

elaine: I'll post SDR snippets and suggested outreach subject lines after lunch.
